Frequency category

From the Primer’s character lists: I = the 871 most common characters of literary Chinese, II = the next 734, III = the next 639, IV = less common. “—” marks Lessons 15–18, which have no character list.

Definitions in

EN shows the Primer’s definitions. 한 · 日 · 中 show the character’s meanings from the Korean, Japanese, and Chinese Wiktionaries (for Chinese, the 說文解字 where Wiktionary has none). You can also switch with the buttons on each card.
